adaptations.entity_operations: Captured read-only entities; all I/O uses explicit Server facade methods with ID or generation-checked handle.
adaptations.querylist: Concrete blessed-array Selection with fixed returns and declarative where/callback grep.
adaptations.refresh: New Snapshot acquisition, no mutation of captured handles.
adaptations.window_context: WindowLink is required for session-relative selection/movement/unlink.
adaptations.interactive_attachment: Caller-owned attach_argv; bounded capture transport does not own a TTY.
adaptations.raw_hooks: Sparse indexes/native quoted values retained in raw output, not flattened.
adaptations.legacy_aliases: Python deprecated aliases are excluded; named native Perl surface plus explicit cmd is authoritative.
adaptations.ui_helpers: Popup/menu/prompt/key-binding/clock/chooser wrappers are excluded; explicit cmd remains available where tmux supports the caller context.
adaptations.other_operations: Buffer save/load file, pane respawn/swap/join/break/pipe, server lock/access, wait-for, run-shell/source-file remain explicit cmd operations without wrapper parity claims.
adaptations.errors: Acquisition never converts failure to empty results.
